head: Riaya
sub: رعاية · a private front door to men's reproductive health
vo: In Abu Dhabi, a man often enters the fertility pathway too late. After months of trying. After his wife has already been assessed.

head: Half the picture is missing
sub: Male factors are involved in about half of couples who struggle to conceive. Men are usually assessed last.
vo: Male factors are involved in about half of couples who struggle to conceive. Yet men are usually checked last. Stigma, privacy and inconvenience keep them away.

head: A private front door
sub: No app store. No account. No name. Arabic first.
vo: Riaya is a private front door. No app store, no account, no name. It opens in Arabic, and offers three ways in.

head: Talk it through
sub: Fourteen questions by voice or chat, in Gulf Arabic or English.
vo: He can simply talk it through. By voice or chat, in Gulf Arabic or English. Fourteen questions, about three minutes.

head: It reads his lab report
sub: Each value with his own lab's range, how sure the reading is, and how the sample was taken.
vo: He can upload a lab report. Riaya reads every value with the range printed by his own lab, shows how sure it is of each reading, and asks how the sample was taken. Nothing is saved until he confirms.

head: Every finding explained
sub: What we saw, why it matters, the evidence, and what it cannot tell him.
vo: Every finding is explained: what was seen, why it matters, how strong the evidence is, and its limits. A what-if view shows how much comes from habits he can change. It is education, never a fertility prediction.

head: One workspace for the doctor
sub: Patient, reasoning and actions side by side, with the evidence one click away
vo: A licensed doctor reviews every specialist referral in one workspace. Any factor opens its evidence, and overriding a suggestion needs a written reason.

head: Care Connect
sub: After the doctor approves, he chooses a clinic and when suits him.
vo: Once the doctor approves, Care Connect opens. He chooses a clinic that offers the care he needs, says when suits him, and sends his summary with a one-time code. No availability is ever invented.

head: The visit is booked and followed
sub: A coordinator confirms the time agreed with the clinic.
vo: A coordinator agrees the time with the clinic and confirms it. He gets a calendar entry that only says appointment. Whether he went, or why not, is recorded, and a missed visit reopens the choice.

head: His results, over time
sub: Each result judged against its own lab's range, and checked by a doctor.
vo: Every result is kept over time and judged against its own lab's range. Riaya flags a sample taken at the wrong time, advises a repeat test before any conclusion, and a doctor checks each value against the report.

head: A twelve-week companion
sub: Habits he chose, reviewed by a doctor, checked in weekly.
vo: Sperm take about three months to develop, so Riaya offers a twelve-week plan. He picks up to three habits, a doctor reviews them, and a weekly check-in shows his progress. Reminders only say weekly check-in.

head: Population health intelligence
sub: Live, de-identified programme dashboard for ADPHC and DoH
vo: For the health system, an anonymised dashboard shows the funnel, time to care, the barriers men report, and fairness across groups. No group smaller than five is ever shown.

head: Or nothing to install at all
sub: The same check on WhatsApp. One word erases everything.
vo: For men who will not install anything, the same check runs on WhatsApp. One word erases everything.

head: Private by design
sub: One tap hides the screen. Encrypted, shared only when he chooses.
vo: One tap hides the screen. His data is encrypted, and shared only when he chooses.

head: Built and tested
sub: 32 automated tests · 26 of 26 guideline scenarios · ready for Microsoft Azure in the UAE
vo: Riaya is built and working: thirty-two automated tests, every guideline scenario passing, and ready for Microsoft Azure in the UAE.

head: Riaya
vo: Riaya. Because the strongest step is the first one.
